page_title: WOL 2-3 EVE | Wolves v Everton 30/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Michael Oliver is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+6' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Iliman Ndiaye leaves the pitch and Seamus Coleman (Everton) comes on.
90+5' The defence just can't clear the ball and a rebound eventually falls to Rodrigo Gomes (Wolves) deep inside the box, but his well-hit shot flies just wide of the right post.

90+4' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and drills a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Jordan Pickford has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The attendance is 30271.
90' Marshall Munetsi (Wolves) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
88' That's the end of the game for Jack Grealish, who is replaced by Carlos Alcaraz (Everton).
86' Tim Iroegbunam (Everton) pulls the trigger and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but his effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
83' Toti (Wolves) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
83' The referee blows his whistle, Wolves are awarded a corner kick.
81' Rough tackle by Rodrigo Gomes (Wolves). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
79' 2 - 3 Goal! Rodrigo Gomes (Wolves) finds himself some space inside the box to get on the end of a pass from David Moller Wolfe, then sends the ball into the roof of the net. 2:3.
76' Substitution. Idrissa Gueye walks off the pitch and Tim Iroegbunam (Everton) comes on as a substitute.
76' Here is a change. Beto is going off and David Moyes gives the last tactical orders to Thierno Barry (Everton).
76' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Sasa Kalajdzic (Wolves) comes onto the pitch for Hee-Chan Hwang.
75' Hugo Bueno just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. David Moller Wolfe (Wolves) replaces him.
74' Hugo Bueno (Wolves) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
73' Fernando Lopez (Wolves) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Michael Oliver who sees an offensive foul.
72' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
67' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
64' The referee signals a substitution. Rodrigo Gomes (Wolves) is brought on as a substitute for Andre.
64' Vitor Pereira has decided to make a change. Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) replaces Jhon Arias.
63' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Jackson Tchatchoua walks off the pitch to be replaced by Fernando Lopez (Wolves).
63' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
63' Dangerous play by Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall (Everton). Michael Oliver blows his whistle for a foul.
60' Wolves enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
58' Santiago Bueno (Wolves) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.

55' 1 - 3 Jack Grealish passes the ball into the penalty area. Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall (Everton) collects it and quickly sends it into the top left corner via the post! The goalkeeper was helpless. 1:3!
53' Marshall Munetsi (Wolves) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Michael Oliver saw the whole situation.
50' A pass out of defence finds Joao Gomes (Wolves) in space, he doesn't think twice and releases a shot from long range which flies well wide of the left post.
47' Iliman Ndiaye (Everton) has a goal ruled out for offside!
47' Idrissa Gueye (Everton) has an effort from close range after latching on to a precise pass, but he can't beat one of the defenders who makes a good block.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+4' Michael Oliver has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
42' James Tarkowski (Everton) commits a rough challenge and Michael Oliver blows his whistle for an infringement.
41' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Hugo Bueno (Wolves), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
41' Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall (Everton) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle. Wolves have been awarded a free kick.
40' Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall (Everton) sends in a cross from a long-range free kick. However, his effort lacks accuracy and the ball sails off the pitch.
39' Andre (Wolves) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Michael Oliver stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
36' Marshall Munetsi (Wolves) shows too much aggression while trying to break free from his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
33' 1 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall sprays a pass out to Iliman Ndiaye (Everton), and he has an easy job to slot the ball into an empty net. The score is 1:2.
33' Jack Grealish (Everton) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his low drive towards the left post, but the keeper dives low to keep the ball out.
33' A clumsy foul by Santiago Bueno (Wolves) and Michael Oliver blows his whistle.
30' Emmanuel Agbadou (Wolves) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
28' Emmanuel Agbadou (Wolves) wins the ball from the resulting corner but blazes it well over the bar.
28' Jhon Arias (Wolves) will take a corner kick.
27' The resulting corner from James Garner (Everton) is cleared by the defence.
26' Jack Grealish (Everton) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. Everton will take a corner kick.
26' Jack Grealish (Everton) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
24' Marshall Munetsi (Wolves) does well to reach the lofted pass in the centre of the box, but doesn't make full contact and his header drifts well past the right post.

21' 1 - 1 Goal! Marshall Munetsi displays great vision and sends a pass to Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball inside the right post. The score is 1:1.
20' Beto (Everton) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
19' Emmanuel Agbadou (Wolves) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Jordan Pickford intercepts the ball.
18' Jake O'Brien (Everton) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
17' Hugo Bueno (Wolves) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch.
16' The foul by Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall (Everton) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Michael Oliver.
16' Jake O'Brien (Everton) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
14' Everton control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
11' Toti (Wolves) tries to find Hugo Bueno, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
7' 0 - 1 GOAL! Beto (Everton) scores with a header from close range after Jack Grealish headed a pin-point lofted cross into his path. It's 0:1.
6' James Garner (Everton) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
6' A pass into the penalty area from Vitali Mykolenko (Everton) is intercepted by the defence. The linesman makes the right call and Everton will have a corner.

4' Jhon Arias (Wolves) has a lack of options after running onto a pass, so shoots from long range. It's a decent effort low towards the middle of the goal, but Jordan Pickford pulls off a comfortable save to deny him.
3' Beto (Everton) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Michael Oliver blows for a foul.
2' James Garner (Everton) sends a cross into the box, but Jose Sa comes off his line to gather the ball.
1' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) heads on.
